headline: Grupo Piñero reaffirms commitment to investment in Dominican Republic
summary: Grupo Piñero CEO Encarna Piñero met with President Luis Abinader to reaffirm the company's commitment to maintaining its investments in the Dominican Republic.
why: Foreign direct investment inflows support tourism-dependent emerging market economies and drive long-term capital formation in regional hospitality sectors.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: Reaffirmed tourism and real estate investments support local economic growth.
